_comment: Pre-registered labels for the L1 threshold review (Phase 5). Written before any verdict was run on the 23 fixture packages. Classes come from fixture metadata: typosquat = misspelling of a popular package; legit-old = first published 2016 or earlier with several maintainers; slopsquat = new single-maintainer package with a 3-day-old account, or a package with a malicious install script; legit-new = published at least 20 days before the snapshot with an established maintainer. Expected: slopsquat and typosquat BLOCK (PRD success metric: 100%); legit-new and legit-old ALLOW (any BLOCK or QUARANTINE is a false positive).
